app.name: NAS power
app.summary: Start a NAS or a server from the screen and shut it down after a question, with its state and power on the tile.
app.control_hint: What starts the device and shuts it down. A script is run for both, so it must do the right one itself; a switch is turned on and off.
app.power_hint: Optional. The power the device draws. It shows on the tile, and tells starting from off before the device answers.
app.idle_hint: Under this power the device counts as off.
